mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs dampen economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where RSAFS shows a sustained increase, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as supply chain disruptions impact corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a single month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% in a single month and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) remains stable (less than 0.2% increase), it signals a strengthening demand without significant inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% and CPIAUCSL increases < 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as lower borrowing costs stimulate economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where FEDFUNDS shows a sustained decrease, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where GDPC1 shows a sustained increase, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
